hero.text: A shipping and logistics partner for businesses that trade internationally.

intro: Autumn Star is a shipping and logistics company serving businesses with international shipping needs. Our focus is ocean freight worldwide, supported by air freight, ground transportation and the coordination that ties a shipment together.
